coverage_rules.verification: Masking agent source-frame contact sheet audit, 2026-10-31. First entry threshold546-564; inside573-687. Second threshold straddle1482-1497; confidently both lenses inside1506-1608; exit straddle1614-1629. These regions assess camera registration and repeat-visit continuity, not mesh completeness.

repeat_visit_groups.name: same_bathroom_two_visits
repeat_visit_groups.interpretation: Both visits depict the same physical bathroom. Compare camera volumes, direct cross-visit feature tracks, and source image orientation; a large disconnected duplicate or folded trajectory must be inspected before training.

heldout_definition: Both lenses of a selected timestamp excluded from photometric training and seed RGB/tracks; camera poses and triangulation were solved with all SfM images

reprojection.method: Independent OPENCV_FISHEYE reprojection, including behind-hemisphere rays; native point.error is not trusted

trajectory_continuity.note: Large relative motion requires visual pose review; walking/turning speed is not constant. No arbitrary discontinuity threshold is imposed.

rig_pair_audit.units: normalized arbitrary world units; not measured metres

repeat_visit_audit.name: same_bathroom_two_visits
repeat_visit_audit.units: normalized arbitrary world units; metric scale unknown
repeat_visit_audit.interpretation: Both visits depict the same physical bathroom. Compare camera volumes, direct cross-visit feature tracks, and source image orientation; a large disconnected duplicate or folded trajectory must be inspected before training.
repeat_visit_audit.limitation: Low residuals or shared tracks do not independently prove that a room is unfolded; visually inspect source-aligned camera paths and sparse structure.

transform.note: One similarity for the whole scene and both lenses. No measured camera height, room-specific transform, crop, floor clamp, or inferred metric baseline.

seed_filter.seed_color_source: Mean of valid train-image RGB samples only; native points3D RGB discarded
